links.outcome: Readability level of AI-generated and manual CHD patient education materials
links.effect: All 3 methods reached Chinese elementary school-level readability for simple sentences and personal pronouns, but high school-level difficulty for words and content word frequency.
links.quote: All 3 methods had similar readability levels and reached Chinese elementary school-level readability for the proportions of simple sentences and personal pronouns, with high school-level difficulty of words and content word frequency.

links.outcome: Accuracy of AI-generated patient education materials rated by experts
links.effect: Accuracy differed across groups (H=7.27, P=.03); accuracy issues in AI-generated materials were noted by 4 of 8 experts, including potential hallucinations.
links.quote: Accuracy issues in the AI-generated materials were noted by 4 of 8 experts.

unlisted_practices: Using generative AI to reduce development time of patient education materials compared with manual creation by a medical team (14 hours vs 0.62 and 0.78 hours)

screen.reason: The study evaluates the capability of two LLMs (ChatGPT-4o and DeepSeek R1) to generate patient education materials compared to human experts across readability, understandability, actionability, and accuracy, but it does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
